user_request: Investigate level-dependent loss weights and a softer FEI-like level/PID preference, and add it properly to the study where applicable.
hypothesis: If representable higher-generation targets receive insufficient effective supervision, component-specific level weighting may improve their correct assembly. If mother-PID errors persist on correct daughter groups, a train-fitted soft level/PID prior may help. Neither premise nor downstream benefit is established.
changed_factor: Diagnostic phase: no production model change. Any admitted ablation changes exactly one selected loss component's level schedule OR the form of the soft level/PID prior, in separate frozen contracts; never both in one contrast.
control: Matched native hierarchical decoder using its actual checkpoint-bound loss/constraint contracts, including current global level weights and soft empirical PID prior. Flat optional-B membership heads are not a valid testbed for this hypothesis.
target_contract: Reconstruction level is generation height, 1+max(daughter generation heights), not mass, FEI stage, depth from a true B root, or source-set cardinality. Preserve complete/partial/unavailable populations and valid shallow heavy-particle decays. Truth is supervision/after-the-fact evaluation only.

existing_mechanisms.weight_scope: Whole reconstruction plus recovery objective, with normalized weighted aggregation; not a new mother-PID-specific schedule.
existing_mechanisms.mother_pid_loss: Matched mother-type cross entropy is present; leaf PID supervision is separate.
existing_mechanisms.soft_prior: Train-observed allowed types by generation height; current default applies -2 logits to unobserved but statically legal types, without hard banning them.
existing_mechanisms.coupling: Mother type bias is applied before expected type embeddings condition daughter pointers, so prior changes may affect grouping as well as PID.
existing_mechanisms.history: Phase36 combined weighting/recovery/threshold changes and does not isolate this effect; Phase41 level-1 pointer-positive reduction traded precision for lower recall. Do not repeat either as if this were untested.

diagnostic_design.roles: Authenticated training identities only for hypothesis selection; no new validation consumption during this audit.
audit_cells: mother PID family and signed token
teacher context versus detached detector-only/model-generated context
measurements: Available, representable, optimized and unavailable target counts per cell.
Unweighted, existing-weighted and per-component loss/gradient contributions, with actual sampling and exposure.
First error: absent legal daughter group, wrong daughter grouping, mother-PID error conditional on an available correct group, object/retention rejection.
Correct generated local/deep proposal production and survival; no inference from oracle reachability alone.
PID confusion/calibration, rare-type support, shallow-heavy and deep-light cases, continuum fake large mothers.
diagnostic_design.no_leakage: Capture generated states before truth joins; no truth PID, B-side, ancestry, future composites or truth subtree size supplied to inference.
diagnostic_design.applicability_gate: Only propose weighting if structurally important represented targets show measured supervision/gradient-allocation deficiency. Only propose prior changes if conditional PID errors and calibration evidence support it. Missing legal daughter groups alone do not justify a stronger PID preference.
diagnostic_design.resources: Use existing guarded bounded CPU diagnostics; scientific jobs remain sequential with the active exposure sequence. Do not alter/cancel running Phase84 contracts or snapshots.

conditional_ablations.trigger: New training-only evidence identifies one undertrained structural loss component and supported generation levels.
conditional_ablations.factor: One bounded mean-normalized generation-height schedule on matched mother-type CE OR daughter structural loss, chosen once from the diagnostic mechanism.
conditional_ablations.fixed: Global level weights, other component weights, object/no-object loss, matching costs, pointer-positive weights, calibration/physics/source/charge penalties, empirical type prior, sampling, corpus, architecture, initialization, updates, thresholds and search.
conditional_ablations.preregistration: Freeze exact supported levels, numerical weights, normalization, resource forecast and success thresholds in a separate plan before training. No coefficient sweep or held-out selection.

conditional_ablations.trigger: Independent conditional mother-PID confusion/rare-channel calibration evidence after the applicability audit.
conditional_ablations.factor: A train-fitted smoothed clipped conditional PID prior compared with the existing observed/unobserved soft prior.
conditional_ablations.fixed: Loss weights, model/data/init/updates, ontology and physical/source constraints, decode/search thresholds.
conditional_ablations.restrictions: Positive support for every statically legal PID, marginal-frequency and rare-type controls, no mass-monotonic rule or hard FEI species list. Coefficient/form/table provenance must be frozen before evaluation. Verify inference/training/export consistency and baseline replay.
conditional_ablations.coupling_note: Type-prior changes also propagate into type-conditioned daughter pointers; report both paths, do not call this a PID-only outcome.

data_and_compute_control.widths: Keep existing widths/depth/geometry initially; use actual hierarchical checkpoint interfaces.
data_and_compute_control.selection: Matched authenticated train identities/order/normalization/init and finite update budgets; independent tiny copies and checkpoints distinguished.
data_and_compute_control.scientific_jobs: At most two matched scientific arms concurrently, after current study sequencing and separate source/cohort/gradient/resource admission.
data_and_compute_control.validation: Fresh development only for a preregistered promising fixed candidate; preserve all historical exclusions and sealed-test boundary.

stop_rule: Stop this branch if diagnostic support is absent, correct daughter groups are structurally unavailable, nonfinite/source/provenance/resource checks fail, or a fixed contrast fails its structural/background endpoint. Preserve the rest of the authorized research sequence; no unmotivated extra weighting variants.
success_rule: Diagnostic success identifies a measurable supported mechanism, not model benefit. Model success requires reproducible raw and constraint-accepted exact daughter/membership improvement and correct deep proposal survival, without increased background or spurious large mothers, shallow/rare-channel regressions, source conflicts or closure violations. Mother-PID accuracy alone or more large-resonance predictions is insufficient. Apply existing tiny/held-out gates before any primary work.

validation_selection.checkpoints: Fixed before any new held-out evaluation; diagnostic curves are not checkpoint selection.
validation_selection.development: Paired immutable reserved fresh non-primary events and full exclusions; report whole-event uncertainty and all trial/event/category denominators.
validation_selection.primary: Not authorized by this addendum; complete evaluation still requires >=2000 distinct processed collisions in each of six categories per arm (>=12000), plus all current gates.

evaluation_endpoints: Raw and accepted exact daughter and retained-source membership by height, PID family and source-set size.
Conditional mother-PID confusion/calibration; rare-channel and shallow-heavy decay coverage.
Correct generated deep proposals and survival, greedy/top1/pool separately where actually supported.
Exact and inclusive B efficiencies and channel/type coverage on an actual hierarchical reconstruction.
Continuum acceptance, background contamination, spurious large mothers, source conflicts and daughter-sum closure.
Exposure, counts/unavailable/failures and actual CPU/wall/RSS/parameter/workload accounting.

workflow.sequence: Append as a conditional native-hierarchy branch after current exposure/information diagnosis, preserving ongoing jobs; do not retrofit flat-head objectives.
workflow.publication: No new per-step public page. The concurrent retrospective publisher remains scoped to previous studies through Phase83.
workflow.planning_validation: A planning pass is not runtime admission, evidence that a loss sweep is allowed, or proof of scientific benefit. Conditional executable plans must bind new mechanism evidence.
